draft_en.subject: L2+ PoE and industrial switches for your reseller channel
draft_en.body:
Hi,

Saga Telecom supplies network distributors with Marvell-based L2+ PoE switches and Centec-based L3 10G/25G/100G switches, under our label or the distributor's own, FCC/CE. Two lines that usually interest MikroTik and WISP channels:

- STC-424XGGPM-280W: 24 x GE PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x 10G SFP+, L2+ managed, USD 170 EXW Shenzhen (snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days).
- STI-288DGGPM: DIN-rail industrial L2+ switch, 8 x GE PoE+ (240 W budget) + 2 x SFP (1G/2.5G), -40 to +75 C, dual DC input, ERPS ring, SNMPv3, USD 137 EXW Shenzhen (snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days), FCC/CE/RoHS, 3-year warranty. Same family: STI-244DGGPM (4 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, 120 W) at USD 121 and STI-488DGGPM (8 x PoE+ + 4 x SFP, 240 W) at USD 147.

Which of the two would be more relevant for your reseller customers - the 24-port PoE for offices and camera sites, or the DIN-rail line?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
